leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a controlled input component to capture user search queries.
Initialize and manage state for the search input value and debounced results.
Implement a debounce function to delay the execution of search logic.
Integrate the debounce function with an event handler to control API call frequency.
Render search results dynamically based on the debounced query.
Configure a cleanup mechanism to cancel pending debounced calls on component unmount.
Apply the debounced search pattern to optimize performance in a real-time filtering scenario.
